source.book: Numerology With Tantra, Ayurveda, and Astrology: A Key to Human Behavior
source.author: Harish Johari

introduction: Rules people born on day 3, 12, 21, or 30, or whose destiny/name number totals 3.
Jupiter = giant, self-illuminating planet radiating more energy than it receives from the Sun; heaviest planet in the solar system.
Known as Guru — "heavy" and "remover of darkness"; teacher of the assembly of Gods (Deva-Guru), of righteousness, justice, and self-illumination.
Planet of courage, boldness, power, hard work, energy, knowledge, and speech; Sanskrit name Vachaspati means "Lord of Speech."
Benefic planet; friends: Sun, Moon, Mars. Rules Sagittarius and Pisces; exalted in Cancer, debilitated in Capricorn; signs of detriment: Gemini, Virgo.
Natural Lord of the 9th house (house of fate) and 12th house — its placement in the natal chart is very significant.
Rules progeny, education, and marriage; in a woman's chart determines her husband's lifespan, status, character, and behavior. A weak Jupiter delays marriage.
Jupiter conjunct or opposed to Sun, Saturn, Rahu, or Ketu, with a Gemini or Virgo ascendant, tends to end marriage in divorce; these configurations create general marriage obstacles.
Makes natives cooperative, active, ambitious, disciplined, pure in behavior; believers in simple living and high thinking.
Rules the liver and the region from the waist to the thighs.
Those born on the 12th of any month are the most fortunate.

psychicNumber: Psychic number of those born on day 3, 12, 21, or 30.
Odd-family number: dynamic, independent, bold, active, hardworking, dependable, popular, disciplined, self-confident, initiators.
Very ambitious; want to achieve something memorable, future-conscious.
Early-life struggle that proves beneficial for their growth and development.
Dislike being subordinates or holding minor jobs; want to be their own boss and create their own projects.
"Scientists of life" — seek practical solutions to make life more colorful and enjoyable; keen observers with good logic; good advisers, teachers, orators, writers.
Flexible — adopt useful elements from all religious practices; religious at heart though not tied to convention; value truth and its practical application.
Love success, crave appreciation; learn conversational tricks, gestures, jokes to gain attention.
Hardworking and restless throughout life, can't fully relax, catnap between jobs, juggle multiple projects; treat duty as yoga — "Devotion to duty is divine."
Usually finish what they start; self-confidence is their keyword.
True to their word, dependable.
Love order and discipline, expect obedience from subordinates; can become dictatorial/tyrannical at home.
Receive help and guidance from elders, relatives, and the well-placed in society.
Strong, healthy, full of stamina; wide circle of friends.
Optimistic, creative, cheerful, humorous — but their teasing/outspokenness earns a (smaller) circle of critics/enemies; they stay unbothered.
Popular with the opposite sex; a weakness for sex, though generally selective, chaste, and loyal to their marital vows; may have physical relationships with psychic-number 1, 3, 6, or 9 partners.
Strongly attached to family; sacrifice personal comfort to preserve family love and harmony; loyal life partners who are usually attractive, chaste, and supportive.
Universal helpers — assist anyone, even enemies, who ask, without bargaining.
Enjoy and benefit from travel; meet celebrities of their time; love riding horses.
Main weaknesses: over-ambition, excessive optimism, extravagance, exaggeration, short temper, uncontrollable dictatorial behavior, jealousy, pride.

Born on the 3rd: more struggle, but beneficial in the end. Born on the 12th: most fortunate/magnetic, less struggle. Born on the 21st: some sadness, less successful (digit 2 influence). Born on the 30th: most unfortunate/struggle-prone (digit 0 influence).
precautions: Avoid the company of low people.
Control temper; eat and drink from silver vessels.
Spend money carefully — it comes and goes easily, creating financial imbalance; save for the future.
Avoid overeating, fats, and hot spices (Jupiter rules the liver); helpful foods: fenugreek seeds, anise seeds, coconut powder, almonds, black pepper, honey with a pinch of saffron.
Avoid boasting about achievements; control anger.
Control passions and sensuality; avoid excess optimism and ambition.
Don't lose heart over small failures; be patient.
Control dictatorial attitudes at home; allow family members their freedom; respect life partners.
Susceptible to skin disease — prevent with regular oil massage; avoid acid/gas-producing foods and eating when not hungry.
Avoid pride; avoid earning money by improper means.
Avoid travel during personally unfavorable times.
Learn to say no — habitual yes-saying invites disappointment when others' expectations aren't met.
Avoid taking on more work or responsibility than they can handle.
destinyNumber: Not considered a favorable destiny number — makes people overload themselves, creating stress, strain, and disorder, though their strong build and stamina let them bear it.
A weakness for sex brings family opposition, though they're lucky enough to escape it.

Outspoken/critical nature creates problems: friends betray them; brothers don't benefit them; failure in love and sometimes bad reputation; selfishness hampers growth; boasting drives people away; pride costs them opportunities; extravagance causes financial crises.
Their luck saves them from most problems including accidents; money comes when needed; they can materialize their dreams.
Natural leaders — rise easily in politics and achieve good government posts.
Rise from ordinary beginnings through hard work, good fortune, responsibility, and planning.
Avoid disputes but sometimes pay out of pocket to smooth over friends/family affected by their impulsive plan changes.
Blessed with a good family life; supportive partners who take on domestic duties and share the couple's many (often needy) friends.
Warm-hearted, generous, fair, trustworthy; earn through a magnetic, charming personality.
Find friends and helpers everywhere; enjoy acting like priests, chanting, and religious work; love ancient history and politics.
Earn through many sources (sometimes questionable means), spend freely on comfort and decoration for others and self.
Creative, imaginative, intuitive, strong writers/speakers — but fame, name, and money usually arrive late in life, not when first desired.
Love good food and comfortable, well-equipped homes; sleep deeply but not long.
Believe in peace and happiness for all.

Best suited for publishing, business, publicity, higher education, research, travel/tourism, import-export, jewelry, law, and teaching philosophy; can also serve religious/philanthropic organizations.
nameNumber: Good as a name number — brings humor, popularity, and willingness to help; society remembers people by their name.
Brings good fortune if harmonious with the destiny number; brings fame and memorability if harmonious with the psychic number.
Name-3 people are bold, trustworthy, self-disciplined, tolerant; good storytellers and eloquent speakers.

If harmonious with both psychic and destiny numbers, adds leadership quality — brings both high position and constant struggle for their ideas/ideals; they become jacks-of-all-trades who act like masters of all trades.
weakPeriods: October and November are not favorable.
Avoid starting new projects or undertaking long journeys during this period.
strongPeriods: February 19 - March 20, and November 21 - December 20 are most favorable.
All new projects should be started during these times; travel during these periods brings long-lasting benefits.
sections.goodDates: Days 3, 12, 21, and 30 of any month are good; days 6, 9, 15, 18, 24, and 27 are also favorable.
sections.goodDays: Thursday is best (ruled by Jupiter) — a day of good news and gains. Monday and Wednesday are also good for financial gain.
sections.favorableColors: Yellow is most favorable — use yellow curtains, pillow covers, and bedsheets; a yellow handkerchief helps remove stress. Pink, blue, or light purple are also good.
preciousStones: Yellow sapphire and yellow topaz are their gems.
Buy and give to the jeweler on a Thursday; ring or pendant made with an open-back setting on a Thursday; pick up and wear (after proper rituals) on a Thursday.
Worn on the right-hand forefinger (the Jupiter finger) as a ring, or as a pendant on a chain/yellow string around the neck; setting and chain should be gold.
Yellow sapphire powder taken to help the body heal electrochemically.
sections.meditation: Meditate on Vishnu — four-armed, sky-blue in color, seated on the serpent Shesha; one hand blesses, the others hold a chakra, a lotus, and a club; his face carries a calming smile.
sections.deity: Vishnu, the preservation aspect of the Supreme Lord in the Hindu tradition.

mantra.repetitions: 19,000 times within the ascending lunar cycle

yantra.description: Yantra of Jupiter — 3x3 numerical magic square (kamea)

healthAndDiseases: Prone to wind/air-related (vata dosha) problems in the Ayurvedic system.
Frail nerves — helped by massage with fenugreek-cooked oil; sesame oil gives the greatest benefit.

Skin problems from aggravated wind (dryness) — helped by garlic, ginger, asafetida, fenugreek in food; avoid indigestion/acidity/constipation; gram (chickpea) flour bread and carrot/carrot juice help; oil massage helps, but excess garlic, ginger, or asafetida cause dryness.
Worrying and uneasiness of mind — helped by meditation, breathing exercises, riverside morning/evening walks, scripture reading, chanting the mantra, and singing bhajans.

Increased sexual urge / lethargy of the male organ — helped by a non-oily/greasy diet, date milk with a pinch of saffron, and oil massage; redirect sexual energy into an absorbing interest to channel it into higher chakras.

Arthritis (aggravated wind) — controlled gas-free diet, massage with Mahanarayan or Wintergreen oil mixed with eucalyptus/mint oils; swallowing garbanzo-bean-sized beeswax balls for 40 consecutive days at the start of winter.
Impurity of the blood — herbal tea fasts, blood-purifying fruit juices, vegetarian/alkaline diet, sprouts, morning walks, breathing exercises, meditation.

Heart troubles — wearing Rudraksha beads as a necklace or armband; eating rose-petal jam (Gulkand); powdered pearls mixed with cream or honey (taken with the ring finger); avoiding fats and hot spicy foods; purification of the abdominal tract/lungs/chest via breathing exercises, vegetarian/alkaline diet, meditation, and relaxing music.
Diabetes — fenugreek seeds (as tea and as a spice in food), breathing exercises, morning walks, gem remedies, and a change of diet and daily habits.

After age 35, watch for poisoning, heat, eruptions, jaundice, and paralysis — frequent use of yellow sapphire powder (in a teaspoon of honey or cream, taken with the right hand's ring finger) protects against many diseases.
sections.fasting: Fast on Thursdays honoring Jupiter — abstain from bananas, laundry, shaving, cumin seeds, and oil (ghee and butter can still be used in food). On the full moon, fast, keep a vow of silence, and chant/meditate at night instead of sleeping. Hindus can recite Vishnu's mantra and the Vishnu Sahasranam, worship Satya Narayan, and hear the katha of Shri Satya Narayan.
sections.friendship: Suitable friends: men and women born on day 1, 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, or 27 of any month. Numbers 5 and 7 are also friendly toward them.
romance: Best matches for romance/marriage: partners born February 19 - March 21 or November 21 - December 21, with a psychic number of 3, 5, or 9.
Secondary matches (same birth windows): psychic numbers 1, 2, 6, and 7 — women should choose 1s or 7s, men should choose 2s or 6s.
sections.goodYearsInLife: The 3rd, 12th, 21st, 30th, 33rd, 36th, 48th, 57th, 66th, and 75th years; any other year divisible by three can also be beneficial.

relationships.1: Good friends (Sun and Jupiter). Threes inspire and draw out 1s' good qualities; 1s make good students/supporters of 3s, who act as advisers ("prime ministers") to 1s' "king." Both are ambitious, forceful communicators, hardworking, authoritative disciplinarians. Ideal pairing: 1-man with 3-woman. Threes should choose 1s for any kind of relationship — 1s do the work, but it benefits both.
relationships.2: Dynamic (3) plus static (2) makes an active combination; 3s understand and can help 2s under any circumstance, staying flexible despite 2's changeability. Threes act as teachers who help 2s grow — mutually beneficial for marriage, friendship, or business. If 2s choose 3s, projects succeed and desires are fulfilled, since 2 is the "Queen" and 3 the "Prime Minister" — 3s work hard and supply energy to 2s.
relationships.3: Uniquely, two 3s benefit each other rather than neutralizing — both work hard and rise up in the world. Not big earners as business partners, but succeed through practical natures and organizing skill. Good for friendship, marriage, or business; number 3s act as "boatmen," helping all numbers across the river of difficulties.
relationships.4: Rahu (4) is not a friend to Jupiter (3), though the reverse is more harmful to 3s than to 4s — in business, 3s lose while 4s gain. As friends, 3s help and understand 4s, who gain strength by following 3s' advice. Marriage works if the 3 is a man and 4 a woman; reversed, it struggles because 4's secrecy and sudden changes are intolerable to 3-women.
relationships.5: Both odd, dynamic, benefic-ruled numbers (Jupiter/Mercury), though Mercury and Jupiter are not friends — Jupiter still helps 5s as a neutral universal helper. Threes advise and befriend 5s; both enjoy being "happy numbers" and free thinkers, making good company. 5's restlessness makes them non-ideal business or marriage partners for 3s, though 3s can learn business from 5-merchants. Marriage works best with 3 as the man, 5 as the woman.
relationships.6: Venus (6, "teacher of demons"/pleasure) and disciplinarian Jupiter (3) are opposite in nature but harmonious as numbers — 3s are drawn to 6s and explore new sides of themselves in their company; slower 6s help fast 3s relax and enjoy life's luxuries. Mutually beneficial in friendship and business; 3s guide 6s toward secret/occult sciences and deepen 6s' spiritual awareness. Best marriage: 3-man with 6-woman; the reverse combination is less ideal.
relationships.7: Ketu (7) is unfriendly to Jupiter, but Jupiter is neutral toward Ketu — both are odd, dynamic "teacher" numbers and independent thinkers; 3s help 7s solve their problems. They don't always think alike but work very well together on shared-interest projects; both are intuitive, reform-minded, and natural writers — strong as friends and business partners. Best marriage: 3-man with 7-woman; the reverse works too, though the woman faces early difficulties before the marriage improves.
relationships.8: Jupiter (3) and Saturn (8) are neutral toward each other. Eight is a struggle-number that works alone and doesn't seek help, so 3s can't really assist 8s; 8s succeed only through great effort and rarely enjoy long stretches of marital happiness. Threes should not choose 8s for marriage. Threes make 8s fortunate through their advice and are generally beneficial to them, but 8s are not very beneficial back, in business or as life partners.
relationships.9: Mars (9) is a friend of Jupiter, making 3 and 9 a friendly, mutually beneficial pair. Three is lucky for 9, and 9 is beneficial to 3; both are strong organizers and hard workers who form a good team. Threes can freely choose 9s for friendship, marriage, or business — 3s don't earn much in the partnership but never suffer a loss, guided by 9s' arrangement and organization, while 3s' good advice helps 9s grow and succeed.
